question: Does the repaired prospective MU breakout-pressure sample now support adding a distinct external route to the funded v53 portfolio?
interpretation: The new resolved lifecycle was a long stop and reduced nominal net by 43.459926 USD and stress net by 45.451736 USD.
The positive headline remains entirely dependent on the first 231.654736 USD winner; removing it makes both nominal and stress totals materially negative.
Both observed short lifecycles lost, so bidirectional robustness is not demonstrated.
Eight completed lifecycles are informative enough to reject immediate promotion but are insufficient to estimate stable long-run expectancy.
The repaired observer may continue collecting future evidence without granting execution authority or reopening the failed frozen transport window.

minimum_additional_evidence.side_requirement: both long and short must have resolved outcomes
minimum_additional_evidence.economic_requirement: nominal and stress totals, medians, and largest-winner-removed totals must be positive after exact costs
minimum_additional_evidence.technical_requirement: entry, mark, book, stop, signal exit, funding, and source identity must be resolved for every evaluated lifecycle
minimum_additional_evidence.selection_requirement: no post-hoc side removal, exit retuning, or replacement of the frozen mechanism

recommendation.Recommendation: Do not add MU to v53 or allocate funded capital. Preserve the report-only observer and reassess only after the predeclared minimum evidence is reached.
recommendation.Why now: The eighth resolved lifecycle is a new adverse outcome that materially weakens the prior outlier-dependent headline.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: The immutable 15-decision lifecycle replay, its seven-lifecycle predecessor, exact causal books, venue candles and funding, WebSocket marks, bounded 0xArchive repairs, development identity, and fee evidence.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: MU produces useful prospective cadence, but observed economics are largest-winner dependent, shorts are 0-for-2, and two lifecycle paths remain technically censored.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Only the prospective market states represented by the fifteen frozen MU decisions through the declared observation cutoff.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Promote now, promote long-only, retune exits, discard MU permanently, or continue unchanged report-only collection.
recommendation.Expected upside: Continued collection can determine whether the first large winner reflects repeatable breakout edge without exposing funded v53 capital.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Small-sample variance, one-winner dominance, one-sided evidence, unresolved mark or depth paths, source-parity mismatch, and post-hoc selection.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact identity, bounded prefixes, realistic fee/funding/friction replay, nominal/stress scenarios, both-side attribution, largest-winner removal, stop ordering, artifact hashing, and no-authority contract.
recommendation.Validation still required: At least twenty technically resolved future-only lifecycles with both sides, exact-source parity, stable after-cost and ex-largest economics, and untouched evaluation rules.
recommendation.Success metrics: Positive nominal and stress net, median, and largest-winner-removed results; profitable evidence on both sides; zero unresolved paths; no source or execution mismatch.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Any promotion remains rejected while ex-largest economics are negative, one side lacks supportive evidence, technical paths are unresolved, or source parity is unproven. No rollback is required because no live change is proposed.
recommendation.Confidence level: high on replay arithmetic and no-promotion disposition; medium on the adverse current diagnosis; low on permanent negative expectancy from eight resolved lifecycles

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Capture and audit the first exact attributable funded v53 lifecycle end to end; MU continues independently as the highest-value external expansion observer without execution authority.
falsifiers: Any evidence hash, bounded prefix, replay arithmetic, side attribution, or no-authority field fails independent verification.
A future preregistered sample of at least twenty technically resolved both-side lifecycles remains positive after exact costs and largest-winner removal.
Source-native candle and L2 decision parity are proven and materially change the reconstructed entries or exits.
The current active v53 profile is shown to have been changed by this report-only experiment.
